versions.changelog:
Initial release of Border Buddy – a comprehensive pre-trip border rules and requirements checker for travelers.

- Provides visa requirements, passport validity checks, Schengen 90/180-day stay calculator, customs/duty-free limits, and health/vaccination certificates for ~50 countries.
- Handles multi-country itineraries, including transit visa checks and edge cases like rolling Schengen rules.
- Delivers concise entry-readiness reports for specified nationalities, destinations, and travel details.
- Offers command-line usage with sample data, entry check, Schengen calculator, and country rules listing.
- Includes comprehensive verification steps and guidance to ensure up-to-date and accurate use.
